meta.name: company-intel
meta.description: Research a company, industry, or competitor set using web search and seven analytical lenses. Use when you need structured intel that feeds downstream PM skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速摸清公司、行业与竞争对手底细，输出结构化情报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解某家公司或某个赛道的竞争格局
copy.tagline_en: Turn web research into structured company and competitor intelligence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand a company or competitive landscape before decisions

howto.what: 让它研究公司、行业或竞争对手时,它会联网搜索,从财务、市场、产品、竞争、趋势、产品管理、战略信号七个角度分析,输出带来源的结构化情报,供后续分析使用。
howto.when: 当用户要求研究某家公司、某个行业或一组竞争对手时触发;若要“发现竞争对手”或给网址也可。入口不明确时会先问一个问题。

say.text: 研究一下 Helix Motion Systems 及其主要竞争对手。
say.note: 会先研究该公司,列出候选对手供确认后再深入。

say.text: 给我临床数据管理行业的情报。
say.note: 按行业入口生成行业级结构化报告。

say.text: 比较 Figma、Canva 和 Sketch 这三家公司的竞争态势。
say.note: 逐家产出报告,并加第12节跨公司对比。

howto.what_en: Researches companies, industries, or competitors via web search; applies seven lenses (finance, market, product, competition, trends, PM, strategic signals); outputs a cited, structured report for downstream work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user names a company, an industry, or a set of competitors. A URL or a 'discover competitors' request also works. If the entry point is unclear, it asks one clarifying question.

say_en.text: Research Helix Motion Systems and its main competitors.
say_en.note: Researches company, lists candidates, confirms first.

say_en.text: Give me intel on the clinical data management industry.
say_en.note: Uses industry entry; outputs sector-level report.

say_en.text: Compare Figma, Canva, and Sketch as competitors.
